question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **agree**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Agree **means to have the same opinion, be in harmony, or reach a consensus. (सहमत)
 
• It involves a mutual understanding or alignment of views.
 
 
• **Example**: *The team members were able to agree on the plan of action for the upcoming project.*
